{{Top|leg}}
'''Police science''' was a subject taught to aspiring detectives at the [[Balaidas Academy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Detien Kaileel]] studied the subject until the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] barred non-[[Human/Legends|Humans]] from attending the academy.
